about: Rev3.0 OVEN CONTROLLER - glass-front carrier (new part family 'GlassFront'). Frozen master parameters for CAD and drawings. Generated by Design Reports/Rev3.0/tools/glassfront/concept/concept_calc.py; study and reasoning in concept.md (sec. 11 = frozen values).
revision: GF-1.1 (2026-11-15: GF-1.0 + stage-3 batch items 1-8 from the Fusion fit findings F1 / F2 and the CadQuery verification; see change_log)
units: mm, deg, N, MPa, kPa unless stated
coordinates: X = KiCad abs x, y = KiCad abs y (down), Z = 0 at the physical PCB back, -Z towards the oven front (frame v2 convention). s = distance outward from the glass edge. Front view: u = -(x - 103.85), v = 82.085 - y.

hardware.name: stud
hardware.value: M4 x 16 CD weld stud ISO 13918 (steel Cu-plated or A2), welded before coating
hardware.note: S4: F1-F4; S8: F1-F8. ISO 13918 PT M4 weld flange dia 5.3-5.7 x 0.7-1.4 sits in the fastener counterbore (GF-1.1). After welding, the stud flange INCLUDING weld collar and flash must lie within dia 5.8 x 1.4 high, and the stud axis must be within +-0.3 of its nominal position relative to the cut-out. Measured with the dia 5.8 x 1.4 envelope and the stud against the slot wall / slot end (worst position, modelled): F1-F4 0.074 to the counterbore wall, 0.053 to the R0.3 floor round, 0.20 to the floor; F5-F8 0.069 / 0.312 / 0.60; no overlap. Reason (frame frozen, so the stud spec is tightened): a dia 5.9 x 1.5 envelope touches the F1-F4 floor round with the stud against the slot wall (overlap <= 0.0025 mm3, ~0.04 deep); a clean dia 5.7 x 1.4 flange clears by 0.10 (wall 0.124, floor round 0.098, floor 0.20).

hardware.name: washer_nut
hardware.value: DIN 9021 M4 (12 x 1.0) + ISO 10511 M4 nyloc, 0.6 Nm
hardware.note: bearing on the tube top (DIN 9021 M4): 80.7 mm2 centred, 76.8 at 0.6 off-centre along the slot, 75.5 at 0.7 across, 65.9 at the slot end (500 N -> 6.2 / 7.6 MPa); off-centre the washer overhangs the coring groove (r 6.2-7.5) on one side - 80 mm2 holds only near the centre

hardware.name: rivet

hardware.note: R4 (GF-1.1 round 3: the dia-10 head kept only 23.7 mm2 of pad face after the counterbore; dia 14: 99.1 mm2)

hardware.name: spacer_S8
hardware.value: DIN 988 7 x 13 x 1.0 shim on the stud between sheet and flange at F5-F8 (bore 7.0: 0.65 radial over a 5.7 flange, 0.60 over the dia-5.8 flange + collar envelope (see stud))
hardware.note: hard stop where no pad is moulded; bears 78.3 mm2 on the flange front (the counterbore opening 7.365 x 8.965 takes the rest of the 94.2 mm2 annulus) and 94.2 on the sheet; OD edge 1.60 from the seat ring (step wall front) and 3.50 from the flange edge; takes 13 mm of the 12-wide gasket / tape band (s 4.5 - 17.5 vs band s 3.9 - 15.9) at each position

At F5-F8 there is no pad and the counterbore opens at the flange front (1.0 deeper), where it measures 7.365 x 8.965 (1 deg draft)

cad_rules: Drive every Z level from the expressions in derived_levels.expressions; never type the evaluated numbers into the model.
glass_t changes only the levels in front of the panel (Z_GLASS_FRONT .. Z_TUBE_TOP); everything at Z >= Z_FORMEX_FRONT is frame v2 geometry.
Step wall (s 0.4 .. 2.9 from the glass edge) is one body from Z_SHEET_BACK to Z_STEPWALL_BACK in every case; union it with the lip, the flange plate and the land plate.

Level snap: if |Z_FLANGE_BACK - Z_LANDPLATE_BACK| < 0.5 (glass_t 1.1 gives 0.10), extend the flange back to Z_STEPWALL_BACK (flange 2.6) so no 0.1 mm step face is created; the stud tube top follows (Z_STEPWALL_BACK + tube_h).
At glass_t 1.1 the recess floor (Z_LAND) lies only 0.10 behind the flange front: keep both faces; they are separated by the step wall, not adjacent.
Lip, seat ring, corner pads, glass recess and pips are formed in the A (fixed) half; parting line on the flange outline in the flange-front plane; single pull Z, no slides.
Tape strips are straight (4 pieces) and end tape_margin before the corner pads; F5-F8 have no moulded front pad so the strips run over them.
Fastener slots are stadiums slot_w x slot_l at the flange front, 0.5 deg draft (wider to the back), long axis = slot_axis (towards the glass centre).
Tail pocket: v2 x limits and walls, bottom face at tr_y1 147.70 with trough_R 1.5, no floor (the glass chin closes the front).

GF-1.1: fastener counterbores 7.4 x 9.0 stadium (slot + 1.0 per side) coaxial with each slot, floor 1.6 (F1-F4, pad) / 2.0 (F5-F8) above Z_SHEET_BACK, R0.3 floor round, 1 deg; the 5.4 x 7.0 slot continues below.

GF-1.1: annular coring groove round every fastener tube from the back, r 6.2-7.5 at the tube top, 3.3 deep, R0.4 floor rounds, 1 deg; the M4 washer sits on the dia-12.4 seat, the M5 rivet backing washer (dia 15) does NOT bridge the groove when centred: its edge lands on the groove's outer edge (r 7.5) and it bears ~88 mm2 on the dia-12.4 seat inside the groove (97-107 off-centre).
GF-1.1: H6 corner cell: cell wall jogged to leave the tail wall 1.1 at Z_PCB, R2.5 corner arc into the boss; no solid fill (thick-section rule: inscribed sphere <= 5.0 everywhere).
GF-1.1: frame outlines are glass-rectangle offsets with corner R_frame + s (R_frame 6.0); the glass corner is R_glass 6.25 and the sheet cut-out corner R_cut 7.55.

GF-1.1 round 3 (moulding): the lip top, the lip faces, the seat ring, the pads (F1-F4 hard-stop faces) and the land are exclusion zones for gates, ejector marks and parting lines; vent witness on the lip top is allowed only if flush within 0.02 (toolmaker to propose); this supersedes 'vents at the lip top every ~50 mm' in the concept text (concept.md).
